title: Tháp đồng hồ cũ
about: Round x19 (album 14), the user: "làm album và chuyển sang sáng tác album mới": sleep music in the style of Sleep in the Dark (ngu-ngon), on a less common progression of its own (template 2), slow (52 bpm), strings, pad, sub, choir, an improvised box tune, then solo. No drums, plucked string or organ. An original piece.
